desc: Parse intervals into (index, l, r, w), sort by right endpoint, build right-endpoint array for binary search.
Compute p_i = count of intervals with right endpoint strictly less than l_i via bisect_left (strict, exclude r == l).
Implement exact-count layer DP j=1..4 storing (best weight, lex-smallest sorted index tuple); transition max(skip, take current + best-(j-1) from prefix p_i); compare tuples only on equal weight.
Final answer: compare exact counts 0..4, pick max weight then lex smallest tuple (shorter-array rule).
Confirm Examples 1 and 2 run to [2,3] and [1,3,5,6].
Fuzz against brute-force oracle (20000 random cases + targeted edge cases): no mismatches, lex tie-break verified.
